name: amm_fee_on_input_swap_signed_benchmark_result
question_template: A constant-product pool holds {R_A} token A and {R_U} stablecoins (1 USD each). Direction {DIRECTION}: sell_a inputs A, buy_a inputs stablecoins; the other is output. Gross input is {TRADE_PCT} percent of the pre-trade input reserve. A {FEE_BPS} basis point fee on gross input is deducted first; only net input enters the invariant, but the full gross input stays in the pool, so the post-trade input reserve includes it. Pre-trade spot is stablecoin reserve over A reserve; effective price is gross USD per A traded; price impact in percent is effective over spot, minus 1, times 100 (signed). Benchmark is spot times one plus {SHOCK} percent (signed). Signed result (gain positive): sell_a, USD out minus gross A in times benchmark; buy_a, A out times benchmark minus USD in. What is the signed result in USD?

slots.description: Units of the output token received after the fee-adjusted invariant swap
Post-trade reserve of the input token including the retained fee
Signed price impact of effective price versus pre-trade spot, in percent
